item.title: Six Flags to sell 7 amusement parks in deal worth more than $330M
item.description: Six Flags will sell seven amusement parks for $331 million, including Michigan's Adventure and Valleyfair, to focus on stronger-performing locations.

item.title: Judge blocks Meta from introducing 'exaggerated' claims in social media trial
item.description: The judge in the social media trial barred Meta's defense from introducing a document where plaintiff Kaley G.M. said she had suffered "sexual abuse during childhood."

item.title: Trump, Bondi sued over TikTok deal that allegedly 'subverted' congressional authority and violated federal law
item.description: Trump and AG Bondi face federal lawsuit over TikTok deal allegedly violating federal law requiring ByteDance divestment from the social media platform.

item.title: US weighs asking China to curb Russian, Iranian oil purchases
item.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent weighs pressing China on energy deals in Paris talks, seeking a shift from Russian and Iranian oil to U.S. energy amid trade negotiations.

item.title: Cracker Barrel sales, traffic continue to slump months after failed rebrand
item.description: Cracker Barrel reports another revenue decline following last summer's rebranding controversy, but CEO Julie Masino sees early turnaround signs emerging.

item.title: United Airlines can now refuse to transport passengers who won’t wear headphones
item.description: United Airlines added headphone language to its refusal-of-transport policy, giving the airline authority to deny boarding to passengers who play audio aloud.

item.title: Wunderfan app rewards sports fans for watching, attending games and engaging with their favorite teams
item.description: Sports loyalty app Wunderfan rewards fans for their passion, offering points for watching games, buying tickets and joining sports discussions.

item.title: Allstate ordered to face privacy lawsuit over alleged cellphone tracking of drivers
item.description: Insurance giant Allstate is facing a privacy lawsuit for allegedly using cellphone tracking data to deny coverage and increase rates for drivers nationwide.

item.title: Wendy's $100k 'Chief Tasting Officer' contest sparks hilarious fast-food social media spat
item.description: Wendy’s launches a $100K Chief Tasting Officer contest running through the end of March as fast-food brands trade jabs on social media over their burgers.

item.title: Target set to open its 2,000th store, plans to open hundreds more in next decade
item.description: Target reaches a major milestone with its 2,000th store opening in North Carolina this month, one of 30 locations set to open this year across the country.
